name: @battleplan/outputs
description: Task output Lambda for code pull requests and research files.

scripts.test:local: vitest run --config ../vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --reporter=verbose outputs && terraform -chdir=terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=terraform validate
scripts.test:agent: vitest run --config ../vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --reporter=junit --outputFile=../test-results/outputs-agent.xml outputs && terraform -chdir=terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=terraform validate
